components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one amber action on a surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M7 5v14l12-7z"/></svg>Play</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.84 0.14 75), oklch(0.66 0.17 48)); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 60); font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.80 0.15 68); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action with an optional keycap.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.285 0.012 60); background: oklch(0.19 0.013 60 / 0.8); color: oklch(0.94 0.012 80); font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: oklch(0.38 0.014 60); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.80 0.15 68); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kbd { font: 600 10.5px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui; color: oklch(0.60 0.016 70); padding: 1px 5px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.285 0.012 60); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(0.165 0.012 60); }

components.name: Genre Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.285 0.012 60); color: oklch(0.72 0.018 70); font: 500 12px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui; }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item in its active state.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav on"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9"><path d="m12 3 2.2 6.8H21l-5.5 4 2.1 6.7L12 16.5 6.4 20.5l2.1-6.7L3 9.8h6.8z"/></svg>Discover</button>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 240px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.72 0.018 70); font: 600 14.5px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { color: oklch(0.94 0.012 80); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04); } .ds-nav.on { color: oklch(0.94 0.012 80); background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.80 0.15 68 / 0.16), oklch(0.235 0.014 60 / 0.7)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.80 0.15 68 / 0.22); } .ds-nav.on svg { color: oklch(0.80 0.15 68); }

narrative.overview: Sonder is a record shop after closing time: warm dark wood, a tube amp glowing in the corner, sleeves everywhere. The interface is that room. Its surfaces are warm near-blacks with a faint film grain, its only light is the amber of the amp, and whatever is playing quietly tints the space around it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, warm, tinted neutrals (hue 60) with film grain; never flat black.
One accent, the logo's amber gradient, reserved for action and "now playing".
A single left sidebar holds the whole navigation and the playlists; it collapses to an icon rail.
Three surface materials: page, sleeve, glass.
Skeletons for every load, staggered reveals, 140–520 ms motion on exponential ease-out curves.
Keyboard first: ⌘K palette, single-key shortcuts shown as keycaps.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent, and it always means action or "now playing". If something amber is neither clickable nor currently playing, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Artwork Owns Its Page Rule
rules.body: A playlist page may be tinted by its own artwork. Nowhere else borrows artwork color; the sidebar glow is amber, never the artwork.

rules.name: The Never-Pure Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff. Every neutral carries chroma 0.012–0.018 at hue 60–80.

rules.name: The No-Mono Rule
rules.body: Metadata uses the UI font with tabular figures, never a monospace.

rules.name: The No-Tracking Rule
rules.body: No positive letter-spacing and no uppercase labels anywhere in the UI.

rules.name: The Grain Budget Rule
rules.body: Grain lives on surfaces, never on content. Page 5%, sleeve 9%, glass 18–22%; nothing else.

rules.name: The Glass Is For Floating Rule
rules.body: Only elements that float above scrolling content are glass.

dos: Do use the logo amber gradient for every primary action and every "now playing" signal, and nothing else.
Do show freshness and connection health plainly: "Checked 4 min ago", "Changed 3 days ago", the sync dot, the expired-cookie alert.
Do give every load a skeleton that matches the final layout; never a centered spinner in content.
Do keep motion between 140ms and 520ms on exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), and honor prefers-reduced-motion everywhere.
Do show the keyboard shortcut next to any action that has one.
Do let a playlist's artwork tint its own header, blurred and faded, never with a hard edge.
donts: Don't look like the generic starter kit: grey on white, no identity, "Laravel Starter Kit" in the corner.
Don't build anything that reads as a SaaS product built for strangers: onboarding funnels, marketing copy inside the app, hero metrics with big numbers and small labels.
Don't copy Spotify: no pure black with neon green.
Don't use monospace or widely tracked uppercase for metadata.
Don't animate on hover for decoration. The waveform means "playing"; it never appears on a row that is merely hovered.
Don't put grain, blur or glass on artwork, text or track rows.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, or glassmorphism on anything that does not float.
